launches.title: Ergo – Revenue infrastructure for high-growth sales teams
launches.tagline: We connect every conversation your team has and build the unified data layer that moves deals forward.
launches.body:
**We're Yash and Ishan, co-founders of Ergo.**

**Ergo is the revenue infrastructure for teams growing faster than their systems can keep up.** We connect the conversations your team is already having, across calls, email, Slack, and more, and build a unified data layer that moves deals forward.

Teams like [Rho](https://rho.co), [RetellAI](https://retellai.com), [Whop](https://whop.com), [Agency Cybersecurity](https://getagency.com), [Corgi](https://corgi.insure), and [Greptile](https://greptile.com) are already running on Ergo.

**📉 The Problem**

Revenue teams are drowning in fragmented data. Your reps are on six different communication channels. None of it connects. None of it acts on itself.

* Deals slip because no one followed up at the right moment
* Leadership asks reps what's happening instead of just knowing
* Marketing sequences run on empty fields because the right data never made it in
* AEs walk into calls without context because handoffs live in someone's Slack DMs

The conversations are happening. The signal is there. It just never goes anywhere.

**📈 The Solution**

Ergo plugs into every channel where your team talks to prospects and customers and builds a unified data layer across all of it. Every call, email, and message gets structured into a single source of truth your entire revenue org can act on.

* **For revenue teams:** Structured deal data captured automatically across every call, email, and message, without touching your CRM
* **For reps:** Follow-ups drafted and surfaced at the right moment, every time
* **For managers and founders:** Real-time pipeline visibility without chasing anyone for updates
* **For RevOps and marketing:** Clean, structured data that actually powers your sequences and reporting

**⚙️ How It Works**

1. **Connect your channels** — Zoom, Google Meet, Gmail, Outlook, Slack, dialers. Wherever your team talks to customers, Ergo listens.
2. **Structure the signal** — Every conversation becomes structured, actionable data across your pipeline.
3. **Execute on what's next** — Follow-ups drafted. Deals surfaced. Pipeline moving. No manual work required.

**🎬 Our Story**

We started at Georgia Tech, and got our first real signal at a YC-backed startup in SF. We spent four days embedded with their sales team and watched 15-20 daily calls evaporate into missed follow-ups and stale records. We built a first version over a weekend that unlocked $75K in closed contracts. That problem turned out to be everywhere.

Today Ergo supports revenue teams running their entire bottom-of-funnel motion, from first conversation to close to expansion, without the admin.

**👉 [joinergo.com](http://joinergo.com)** Questions? [yash@joinergo.com](mailto:yash@joinergo.com) or [ishan@joinergo.com](mailto:ishan@joinergo.com)
